name: Norstar Holdings Inc.
summary: Norstar Holdings Inc., through its subsidiaries, acquires, develops, rents, and manages real estate properties in the North America, Israel, Brazil, northern Europe, and Central and Eastern Europe. It develops and trades in office and residential buildings. The company was formerly known as Gazit Inc. and changed its name to Norstar Holdings Inc. in May 2011. Norstar Holdings Inc. was founded in 1962 and is based in Ramat Gan, Israel.
